Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If I have a Society of Leopold and Anarch Revolt in play.

Society burns my prey's only anarch during his master phase.

Can my prey order his master phase to avoid taking the Anarch Revolt
Damaage?

Messages.Author: D.J.
Messages.Body:


Assuming you mean Untap Phase for all of the above (as that's when the
cards actually trigger) I don't see why not... You can't leave the
Untap phase without dealing with them, but they're both "During"
effects, so it'd be OK to check them in either order.

- D.J.

phase.

SoL - "During his or her controller's untap phase,"

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


I'm suggesting that the card text is followed: "A Methuselah who does not
control a ready anarch burns 1 pool during his or her untap phase."

Anarch Revolt has not effect on a Methuselah who controls a ready anarch, by
card text. There is no effect to be ordered amongst the other "during untap"
effects.

The effect is "burn 1 pool during the untap phase" not "during your untap phase,
check to see if you control a ready anarch and if you do not, burn 1 pool".

If you do not control a ready Anarch, then you have an effect to order. If one
of the other effects you choose to apply before this effect causes you to have a
ready anarch, then you would no longer have this effect to apply (unless you
somehow managed to cease having a ready anarch again before phase end).

Another useful reference may be Arika:

Arika's Prey cannot end her untap phase if she controls a location
that she hasn't burned a pool for, even if she gained control of that
location sometime during her untap phase. [LSJ 19990405]

An analog might be: While Anarch Revolt is in play, a Methuselah
cannot end her untap phase if she does not control an Anarch and has
not burned a pool to Anarch Revolt, even if she controlled an Anarch
sometime during her untap phase.
